feeds.title: Pall Mall Barbers Blog
feeds.description: Pall Mall Barbers is one of the oldest and most respected barbershops in London. This blog features men's haircuts and re-styles, beard trimming and shaping and shaving lessons. It also offers men's grooming product collections, which includes dressing creams for men's hair, shaving creams, shaving brushes, double edge razors, beard oils and moustache wax.
